records.title: Essence Mascara Lash Princess
records.description: The Essence Mascara Lash Princess is a popular mascara known for its volumizing and lengthening effects. Achieve dramatic lashes with this long-lasting and cruelty-free formula.

records.title: Eyeshadow Palette with Mirror
records.description: The Eyeshadow Palette with Mirror offers a versatile range of eyeshadow shades for creating stunning eye looks. With a built-in mirror, it's convenient for on-the-go makeup application.

records.title: Powder Canister
records.description: The Powder Canister is a finely milled setting powder designed to set makeup and control shine. With a lightweight and translucent formula, it provides a smooth and matte finish.

records.title: Red Lipstick
records.description: The Red Lipstick is a classic and bold choice for adding a pop of color to your lips. With a creamy and pigmented formula, it provides a vibrant and long-lasting finish.

records.title: Red Nail Polish
records.description: The Red Nail Polish offers a rich and glossy red hue for vibrant and polished nails. With a quick-drying formula, it provides a salon-quality finish at home.

records.title: Calvin Klein CK One
records.description: CK One by Calvin Klein is a classic unisex fragrance, known for its fresh and clean scent. It's a versatile fragrance suitable for everyday wear.

records.title: Chanel Coco Noir Eau De
records.description: Coco Noir by Chanel is an elegant and mysterious fragrance, featuring notes of grapefruit, rose, and sandalwood. Perfect for evening occasions.

records.title: Dior J'adore
records.description: J'adore by Dior is a luxurious and floral fragrance, known for its blend of ylang-ylang, rose, and jasmine. It embodies femininity and sophistication.

records.title: Dolce Shine Eau de
records.description: Dolce Shine by Dolce & Gabbana is a vibrant and fruity fragrance, featuring notes of mango, jasmine, and blonde woods. It's a joyful and youthful scent.

records.title: Gucci Bloom Eau de
records.description: Gucci Bloom by Gucci is a floral and captivating fragrance, with notes of tuberose, jasmine, and Rangoon creeper. It's a modern and romantic scent.
